moat_against: Moat is bought, not built — goodwill-heavy roll-up, integration and amortization drag
Competition from FIS, Fiserv, Broadridge, custodian outsourcing and client in-sourcing
Organic growth only mid-single-digit — no network-effect acceleration
AI/automation can compress per-transaction services pricing over time
moat_for: High switching costs — fund accounting/admin migrations take years and carry operational risk
Recurring multi-year contract revenue with ~97% reported retention
Scale as a leading independent fund administrator across alternatives, wealth and healthcare
Cross-sell across 20,000+ installed clients and acquired networks (e.g. Calastone)
Pricing/margin discipline — 39.5% adjusted EBITDA margin in Q2 2026
moat_justification: Core fund-administration and investment-operations systems are deeply embedded and painful to migrate, with high revenue retention and scale from serial acquisitions, but the moat is assembled by M&A, organic growth is mid-single-digit, and large platform rivals and in-house builds cap pricing power.
name: SS&C Technologies Holdings, Inc.
one_liner: Durable, levered financial-software compounder, moat 6/10 — does not clear 15% at $84.19 (weighted IRR 12.6%, IV@15 $67.10); it clears the hurdle only at or below ~$67.
